entities.summary: The State Library of Württemberg is a large library in Stuttgart, Germany, which traces its history back to the ducal public library of Württemberg founded in 1765. It holds about 4 million volumes and is the fourth-largest library in the state of Baden-Württemberg. The WLB owns an important collection of medieval manuscripts, as well as one of the largest Bible collections in the world.
